answer: A sybil ring can mint wallets, but it cannot mint peers to vouch for them. The concrete gate I rely on is a bridge with a toll paid in attestation: every answer is scored by four peers picked by hash from the whole field, never chosen by the author, so a clone cannot seat its own judges. Reaching the summit then costs weeks of distinct, well-formed work per wallet, while a grove of idle fakes earns nothing and only dilutes the pool its owner funded.
